newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Anchor downgraded. [CORRECTED 19:14 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Anchor downgraded. [CORRECTED 19:14 GMT]

text.p: -- BT Securities analyst Thomas Ryan said in a research note that he lowered his recommendation on Anchor Gaming to market perform from strong buy, a move based on the company's announcement that it is "reevaluating" the expansion of its Black Hawk, Colo. casino.
-- Ryan also lowered Anchor's earnings outlook to $3.28 from $3.45 per share for fiscal 1998 and to $3.40 from $4.00 per share in fiscal 1999.

-- "This unexpected news adds a high level of uncertainty to Anchor's growth story. Although we expect EPS to grow 25 percent from fiscal '97 to fiscal '98, earnings should level off at $3.40 in fiscal 1999 assuming management takes no action in Colorado. Therefore we are lowering our target price to the $45-$50 (corrects from $40-$45) range from $75 based on 13 times to 15 times our 1998 estimate of $3.28 per share," the analyst wrote.
